extra_vocab.en: an outdoor meal in which food is cooked on a grill
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於公司野餐、員工聯誼和餐廳廣告，語氣輕鬆。口語和招牌常縮寫成 BBQ。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: barbecue 指烤肉活動時是可數名詞（hold a barbecue）；指烤肉這種食物時是不可數（some barbecue）。

example.en: The company organizes two barbecues for employees every summer.
example.zh: 公司每年夏天為員工舉辦兩場烤肉活動。

example.en: He barbecues chicken for the whole team every Friday.
example.zh: 他每週五都為整個團隊烤雞肉。

example.en: They barbecued fish and corn for all the guests.
example.zh: 他們為所有賓客烤了魚和玉米。

example.en: The restaurant serves barbecued pork with rice and vegetables.
example.zh: 這家餐廳供應烤豬肉配飯和蔬菜。

example.en: We are barbecuing sausages at the staff picnic on Saturday.
example.zh: 星期六的員工野餐上，我們要烤香腸。

example.en: Our department will hold a barbecue to welcome new staff.
example.zh: 我們部門將舉辦烤肉活動來歡迎新同事。

example.en: The restaurant makes its own barbecue sauce every morning.
example.zh: 這家餐廳每天早上自己調製烤肉醬。

example.en: Please clean the barbecue grill after the picnic ends.
example.zh: 野餐結束後，請把烤肉架清理乾淨。

examples.en: The annual company barbecue will be held at the riverside park.
examples.zh: 一年一度的公司烤肉活動將在河濱公園舉行。

examples.en: Please let me know by Thursday if you can join the barbecue.
examples.zh: 如果你能參加烤肉活動，請在星期四前告訴我。

examples.en: Our barbecue menu includes beef, chicken, and grilled vegetables.
examples.zh: 我們的烤肉菜單包含牛肉、雞肉和烤蔬菜。

similar.diff: grill 當動詞指在烤架上用直火烤；barbecue 常指整個烤肉活動，或慢烤並刷醬的料理。

example.en: The chef will grill steaks in front of the guests.
example.zh: 主廚會在賓客面前烤牛排。

similar.diff: cookout 是美式口語，指戶外烹調食物的聚會；barbecue 更常用，也指食物和烤架。

example.en: The office cookout starts at noon on Saturday.
example.zh: 辦公室的戶外烤肉聚會星期六中午開始。

example.en: The company picnic is scheduled for the first Saturday of June.
example.zh: 公司野餐訂在六月的第一個星期六。

example.en: Please turn off the grill before you leave the park.
example.zh: 離開公園前請先關掉烤架。

example.en: A local firm will provide the catering for the event.
example.zh: 一家當地公司將為這場活動提供外燴服務。

example.en: The barbecue starts at noon, so please arrive on time.
example.zh: 烤肉活動中午開始，所以請準時抵達。

example.en: Volunteers will barbecue chicken and corn for the fundraiser.
example.zh: 志工將為募款活動烤雞肉和玉米。

senses.en: an outdoor party where food is cooked on a grill

example.en: The staff barbecue was a great chance to meet colleagues.
example.zh: 員工烤肉聚會是認識同事的好機會。

senses.en: meat cooked on a grill, often with a special sauce
senses.distinguish: 前面接 order、serve、eat 這類動詞，並且不加冠詞時，通常指食物。

example.en: We ordered barbecue and salad for lunch at the office.
example.zh: 我們在辦公室午餐點了烤肉和沙拉。

senses.en: a metal frame used to cook food outside
senses.distinguish: 出現 use、clean、in the garden 等字時，常指烤肉的設備。

example.en: The hotel garden has a large barbecue that guests can use.
example.zh: 飯店花園裡有一座大型烤肉架，賓客可以使用。

extra_vocab.en: a container made of thin strips, used for carrying things
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於零售和網路購物（add to basket）、禮品籃、水果籃等情境。網購網站的「購物車」常用 basket（英式）或 cart（美式）。

example.en: Fresh fruit baskets were placed in every meeting room.
example.zh: 每間會議室都放了新鮮水果籃。

example.en: Customers can pick up a shopping basket at the store entrance.
example.zh: 顧客可以在店門口拿購物籃。

example.en: The company sent a gift basket to every client at New Year.
example.zh: 公司在新年時寄了一個禮籃給每位客戶。

example.en: Click here to add the item to the basket and check out.
example.zh: 點這裡把商品加入購物籃並結帳。

example.en: She brought a basket of fresh bread to the staff meeting.
example.zh: 她帶了一籃新鮮麵包到員工會議。

examples.en: Your basket is empty; please add items before you check out.
examples.zh: 您的購物籃是空的，結帳前請先加入商品。

examples.en: The store provides baskets near the entrance for easy shopping.
examples.zh: 商店在入口附近提供籃子，方便購物。

examples.en: Each guest received a small basket of snacks and tea.
examples.zh: 每位賓客都收到一個裝有點心和茶的小籃子。

confusable.diff: basket 後面加 ball，意思變成「籃球」這項運動，不是籃子。

example.en: Our team joined a local basketball league this spring.
example.zh: 我們的團隊今年春天加入了當地的籃球聯賽。

similar.diff: cart 是有輪子的推車，裝得比較多；basket 是用手提的小籃子。

example.en: Please leave your shopping cart near the exit.
example.zh: 請把你的購物推車留在出口附近。

example.en: Store the leftover food in a clean container.
example.zh: 請把剩下的食物放進乾淨的容器裡。

example.en: The checkout page asks for your address and payment details.
example.zh: 結帳頁面會要求輸入地址和付款資料。

senses.en: a container used for carrying or holding things

example.en: Place the files in the basket on my desk.
example.zh: 請把文件放進我桌上的籃子。

senses.en: the place where items are kept before you pay
senses.distinguish: 出現 add、check out、online store 等字時，指的是購物籃或購物車。

example.en: Two items remain in your basket from your last visit.
example.zh: 您上次造訪時留下的兩件商品還在購物籃裡。
